# Code review: WalletConnect wallet-side requests, QR scanners and share sheet

Full review (all 9 areas, findings checked, scored) of `git diff 7e291b75f...HEAD` · 73 files, +4,431 −525 · base `6478941` → `244191a` (committed only).

**Verdict: Approve · 97/100.** There is nothing to fix before merging. The two Medium issues are worth doing but can wait: a race that can send a dApp two answers to one request, and EIP-5792 status logic copied from web instead of shared.

| | |
|---|---|
| What held the score down | BUG-001 (the race) and DRY-001 (copied status logic), then three missing tests |
| Fix first | BUG-001: after building the transaction, check the request is still pending before handing it on |
| Checking coverage | 12 of 16 findings checked by a pair of agents (one confirms, one tries to disprove): 7 confirmed, 5 contested, 0 disproved. The 4 unchecked ones are 3 Nits and 1 Low |

## Scores by area, worst first

| Area | Score | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Testing | 91 | 3 confirmed missing tests (Low) |
| Bugs | 92 | BUG-001 (Medium) |
| DRY | 92 | DRY-001 (Medium) |
| KISS | 97 | KIS-001 (Low) |
| Conventions | 97 | CNV-003 (Low, unchecked) |
| Security, regression, architecture, performance | 100 | No confirmed findings |

## What this review did not cover
- Nothing was run: no tests, no app, no library source under `node_modules` (this worktree has none installed).
- SEC-001 depends on how `@reown/walletkit`'s `getPendingSessionRequests()` behaves across a restart. That was not read from the library source.
- CNV-003, DRY-003, TST-005 and TST-006 were not checked by the agent pair. They are scored at full weight, so treat them as claims, not verdicts.
- There was no previous run to compare against. The run record was not written, and the cleanup-proposal stage was skipped, because this review was read-only.

## Worth doing, but not blocking (P3)

**BUG-001 · Medium · confirmed by both agents**
`apps/mobile/src/features/WalletConnect/Wallet/hooks/useSendTransaction.ts:68-105` (with `context/WalletKitProvider.tsx:199-252`)
- **What happens:** `review()` waits on `composeSafeTxDraft` (the CGW `/preview` call) while the request is still in `pending`. During that wait, the Safe/chain switch listener can fire, remove the entry and send the dApp `USER_REJECTED`.
- **What triggers it:** a second dApp session calling `wallet_switchEthereumChain`, which is approved automatically (`methodRouter.ts:144-155`).
- **Then:** `review()` resumes, sets the request as outstanding and opens the confirm screen anyway. If the user signs, a second `respondSessionRequest` fails silently.
- **Effect:** the dApp thinks the transaction was rejected, but the Safe transaction is still proposed.
- **Fix:** after the wait, check the entry is still in `pending` before `setOutstandingRequest`, or mark it as being built so the listener skips it. This mirrors the existing `outstanding.proposing` guard in `WcRejectOnBack.tsx:51-60`.

**DRY-001 · Medium · confirmed by both agents**
`apps/mobile/src/features/WalletConnect/Wallet/services/getCallsStatus.ts:39-85`
- **What:** `mapTxStatus` and `buildGetCallsResult` copy web's `BundleTxStatuses` and receipts logic (`apps/web/src/services/safe-wallet-provider/index.ts:99-113`, `:439-488`). The file's own comments say it was copied from web.
- **Risk:** the two platforms will drift. Web already has a `PARTIALLY_REVERTED = 600` status that mobile can't express.
- **Fix:** move it into `packages/utils/src/features/walletconnect/eip5792.ts` and call it from both apps.
- **Correction:** that shared helper file is currently used by mobile only, not by both apps as the original finding said.

**Testing (Low, all confirmed by both agents).** Each item names code with no test that runs it:
- **TST-002:** `WalletKitProvider.tsx:299-317`. Neither `NOT_DEPLOYED` check in `switchActiveChainByCaip2` ever runs in a test; every test replaces the function with `jest.fn()`.
- **TST-003:** `WalletKitProvider.tsx:323-362`. The `getCallsStatus` function in the provider is never run. None of its three receipt outcomes is tested: fetched, fetch failed, or no chain config. Only the pure `buildGetCallsResult` helper is tested.
- **TST-004:** `components/RequestSheetHost.tsx:105`. The `composing` half of `if (busy || composing) return` has no dismiss-while-building test. The `busy` half does (`RequestSheetHost.test.tsx:165`).

**KIS-001 · Low · confirmed by both agents**
`apps/mobile/src/features/WalletConnect/Wallet/context/WalletKitProvider.tsx:40-403`
- **What:** the component body grew from 121 to 364 lines, and three separate jobs were added inline:
  - the propose-response listeners (137-191)
  - rejecting stale requests on a Safe switch (199-252)
  - building the dependencies for the request handler (285-391)
- **Why it matters:** `apps/web/docs/code-style.md:92-94` sets function-length and single-responsibility limits, and `apps/mobile/AGENTS.md:26` says they apply to mobile.
- **Fix:** move each into its own hook, as this PR already does with `useSessionRequestHandler` and `useSendTransaction`.

**CNV-003 · Low · not checked by the agent pair**
`services/methodRouter.ts:106-273` and `services/getCallsStatus.ts:42-43`
- **What:** the router dispatches on 8 sequential `if (method === …)` blocks, and the status mapping is a chained ternary.
- **Why it matters:** `apps/web/docs/code-style.md:47-58` says 5 or more conditions should become a lookup table, and mobile follows that doc.

## Your call
| ID | Decision |
|---|---|
| BUG-001 | Fix in this PR (small guard) or ticket |
| DRY-001 | Ticket: a cross-platform extraction into `packages/utils` |
| TST-002/003/004 | Add in this PR, or ticket together with a KIS-001 hook split, which would make them easy to test |
| KIS-001, CNV-003 | Ticket or skip |

## Nits (no score impact)
| ID | Where | Note |
|---|---|---|
| DRY-002 | `methodRouter.ts:74-104` | Call-shape check copied from web `index.ts:410-422`. Confirmed, but reduced to Nit: it is a ~10-line predicate |
| DRY-003 | `ImportReadOnly/hooks/useScan/index.ts:8-59` and `Send/ScanQrSend.container.tsx:38-91` | Near-identical scan logic. Only 2 copies, so it doesn't yet need extracting |
| TST-005 | `components/DappIdentity.tsx:43-47` | The fallback for a URL that doesn't parse is untested |
| TST-006 | `components/SegmentedControl/SegmentedControl.tsx:40-46` | The spring on a value change is never triggered; no test re-renders |

## Not sure about these (contested, below the confidence needed to count)

**SEC-001** · `WalletKitProvider.tsx:47-93`
- **Claim:** requests restored after a restart skip the router's signer and chain checks (`methodRouter.ts:223-240`).
- **For:** confirmed; the chain check really is missing on the restore path.
- **Against:** Review always builds against the live active Safe; any later Safe or chain switch clears stale requests; and `ConfirmTxForm.tsx:38` blocks signing without a signer.
- **My read:** the gap only opens if the stale-request rejection never reached the dApp before the app was killed, or the request was picked up only at restart. A one-line check of `chainId` against the active chain at `:75` would close it.

**BUG-002** · `methodRouter.ts:74-82`
- **Claim:** a malformed `to` passes the check.
- **For:** the request stays unanswered, and only fails at `services/tx/draft.ts:58` with a "Failed to build transaction" toast.
- **Against:** this is intended and fails safe. Reject and dismiss still answer the dApp, and `useSendTransaction.test.ts:83-95` documents the behaviour.

**TST-001** · `ConfirmTx/ConfirmTx.container.tsx:66-95`
- **Claim:** there is no container test for the dApp origin and back-rejection wiring.
- **Against:** the repo's testing guide (`apps/web/docs/TESTING.md:13`) exempts JSX-only glue, and only 22% of mobile containers have their own test.

**CNV-001** · `ConfirmTx/components/TransactionHeader/__tests__/TransactionHeader.test.tsx:1`
- **Claim:** the test isn't next to its source, against `AGENTS.md:392`.
- **Against:** the sibling `TransactionChecks/` also uses `__tests__/`, and 113 of 333 mobile test files do.

**CNV-002** · `TransactionHeader.tsx:11` and `ConfirmTx.container.tsx:20`
- **Claim:** ConfirmTx imports WalletConnect components, against `apps/mobile/docs/code-style.md:9`.
- **Against:** 51 of 128 feature-to-component imports already cross features, and this exact `DappIcon` import existed before this diff (`TransactionHeaderLogo.tsx:8`).

## Ruled out
- **Performance:** the provider cache, receipt fetches, rejection fan-out and network list are all bounded by the chain count or by in-flight requests.
- **Regression:** the `chainIdToHex` switch to BigInt, the removal of `getAvailableChainsNames` (no callers left), the move from `prepareSendDraft` to `draft.ts` (same behaviour), the new `OutstandingTxRequest` fields (this slice isn't persisted), and the renamed testIDs.
- **Architecture:** `WalletKitProvider` imports 18 of its own modules, under the 20 limit; the `providerCache` map is a deliberate, tested memo.
- **Security:** `READ_ONLY_RPC_ALLOW_LIST` contains no signing methods, and `supported-networks` is in `protectedRoutes`.

## How this was produced
- **Passes:** 9 run in parallel, producing 16 findings, including 3 that one area handed to another and that area never filed (CNV-002, CNV-003, BUG-002).
- **Checking:** a confirm-and-disprove agent pair checked 12 of the 16.
- **Scoring:** per-area scores are weighted into the overall with no caps triggered. Approve comes from the overall score, and the explicit commit range selects the PR-review verdict wording.
- **Reliability note:** the KISS pass ended with a stray summary line that matched none of the passes' output. I ignored it.
